directives-toolkit — commands

The 13 slash commands in the directives-toolkit plugin, grouped by development-pipeline phase, each described by its own command file.

Type /<name> to run a command. 2 of 13 are marked typed only; Claude may start any other one itself when a step or a directive calls for it. For the always-current menu read live from the installed plugin, run /my-list. Auto-skills (doc-comp, scope-chk, update-pages) fire on their own and are not listed here.

Think

/diagnose
Understand the problem before building: one question at a time, 2-3 approaches with tradeoffs, then specs/<slug>/brief.md. Run before /sdd-loop; no 'too simple' exemption.

Plan

/kickoff typed only
Start a spec-driven build of a new app — scaffold, product brief, optional discovery, then /sdd-loop.
After — /new-repo
/sdd-loop [specify|plan|implement|status] [feature-slug]
Spec-driven build loop with the inherited directives as the constitution.
After — /kickoff, /diagnose

Build

/design-intake
Set up a project's look — adopt the house tokens.css + components.css (or, by owner ruling, import a palette into them), build an approved reference page, then hand off to /sdd-loop.
After — /kickoff
/new-repo
Bootstrap a brand-new project — fires only when CLAUDE.md does not exist yet.

Review

/audit-repo
Audit the repo for directive drift, code correctness, duplication, and structural soundness. Reports findings; changes nothing without approval.

Test

/commit-chk
Run the pre-push verification manually — tests, lint, CI status.

Reflect

/handoff-session
Write a delta-only handoff for a fresh session.
/learn
Use when a lesson should outlive this session — the user asks to remember something, note it for next time, or make sure future sessions know it, or a pitfall, preference, architecture decision or tool fact just cost real time. Appends a confidence-scored entry to learnings.jsonl.

Cross-cutting

/do-repo <owner/repo> [inspect|compare <target>|audit]
Inspect, compare, or audit any public GitHub repo over raw URLs and git — read-only, no checkout.
/env-chk
Session readiness — git health, CI status, validation gates, directive freshness, skill shadowing, tool inventory, and repo-scope verification.
/my-list
List the toolkit's commands and auto-skills — read live from the plugin.
/refresh-repo typed only
Re-sync this project with claude.directives mid-session — re-read the rules and report the upstream delta since the last sync.
